summary: Overview of responsibilities and technical ownership.
Spearheading mobile application development across high-volume e-commerce and enterprise HRMS ecosystems, integrating native modules, real-time push services, and resilient state synchronization.
productsShipped: Panchalivastra (E-Commerce Mobile Application / React Native & Expo)
Rantaa (E-Commerce Mobile Application / React Native & Expo)
Elitecraft HRMS (Enterprise Human Resource Management System)
Atmos HRMS (Enterprise Human Resource Management System)
responsibilities: Developed Panchalivastra and Rantaa mobile applications and contributed to 2+ additional e-commerce applications using React Native and Expo.
Contributed to 2+ HRMS applications, including Elitecraft HRMS and Atmos HRMS, implementing mobile features and application functionality.
Integrated REST APIs, authentication mechanisms, and backend services to enable secure access and reliable data exchange.
Implemented push notifications, loading states, animations, and interactive UI features to improve application functionality and user experience.
Debugged, tested, and troubleshot application issues, implementing fixes based on functional requirements.
Used Git and GitHub for version control and collaborated with web development and DevOps teams on integration, testing, and deployment.
Took ownership of assigned mobile development tasks and implemented features to support project delivery.
